title: A Space Probe Returns to Asteroids Where NASA Tested Planetary Defense Systems
summary: Several years ago, NASA tested systems for deterring dangerous space rocks. Now, a probe from the European Space Agency is returning to the scene to investigate.
llm_summary: A few years ago NASA used a spacecraft to test techniques for deflecting potentially hazardous asteroids, experimenting with kinetic‑impact and other “planetary‑defense” methods. Now the European Space Agency’s Hera probe is heading back to the same target asteroid to study the aftermath, gather detailed data on the impact crater and assess how effective the deflection was
